title: G&T-seq
scope: Macaulay 2015 G&T-seq implementation as depicted by the Illumina G&T-seq schematic and corresponding poster rows: isolate and lyse one cell, capture poly(A) RNA on magnetic beads, retain physically separated RNA and genomic-DNA branches, independently amplify with Smart-seq2 and MDA, then sequence and align both branches. Smart-seq2 is an embedded subprotocol. Neighboring DR-Seq, scM&T-seq and scTrio-seq rows, the EDTA legend drawing, and catalogue-associated kit lists do not expand this target.

operations.label: Capture poly(A) RNA on bead-associated oligo(dT)
operations.description: Introduce the depicted biotinylated oligo(dT) capture primers and streptavidin magnetic beads into the RNA-capture block. operations.mechanism: Poly(A)/oligo(dT) hybridization supplies RNA recognition; the biotinylated capture primer is retained on streptavidin-coated magnetic beads.
operations.information_effect: Selection is directed at polyadenylated RNA, rather than all RNA species. The drawing does not establish perfect recovery or purity.

method_scopes.rationale: All listed operations apply to the named G&T-seq row in the scoped Macaulay 2015 depiction. The verified matching 2015 paper is available here only as metadata and abstract: it establishes separate genome/full-length-mRNA sequencing, while bead capture, Smart-seq2 and MDA are directly supported by the diagram and secondary method description. The later scM&T-seq full text corroborates the inherited separation and RNA-derived cDNA interface only; its bisulfite DNA workflow is excluded. Independent branch-specific sequencing and alignment instances preserve the two routes beneath shared captions. The initial yellow-highlighted RNA/DNA vignette is a target declaration, not an additional extraction reaction. No pooling or distinct computational integration operation is specified by the diagram.
